## Styling

[Ant Design](https://ant.design) backs `src/components/{Button,Input,Modal,Spinner}.jsx` — `Button`/`Input`/`Modal`/`Spinner` wrap antd's own. Note antd's `Button` `type` prop means style variant, not HTML button type, so the wrapper maps our `type` to antd's `htmlType` for you. Every other module (`auth-react`, `router-react`, `state-zustand`, ...) only ever imports from `./components/*`, so it works unchanged no matter which styling library is picked — this is the one place Ant Design is actually wired in.

A real `ConfigProvider` (`theme: { algorithm: darkAlgorithm | defaultAlgorithm }`) lives in `src/theme/ThemeContext.jsx`, driven by the same light/dark/system `ThemeToggle` (antd's own `Segmented` + `@ant-design/icons`) every styling option ships.
